name_zh: 楓（主幹 S 形往一側掃出再回正、葉層往斜的那側展開）
work_pack: 2026-11-11 B｜64 小時：世界裡的樹全部重做（九種），B 批
note: TR04 Chinese maple (楓) in autumn, broadleaf engine tr_broad (golden-spirit-tree method: real wood, leaves on the twig tips).
origin: trunk base centre, z = 0 on the ground; roots go down to z = -0.3
collision_note: TR04_B_Maple_Collision: 8-sided prism around the trunk (radius 0.25 m, z 0-3 m); hide its renderer and use it as a MeshCollider or replace it with a CapsuleCollider of the same size. The crown does not block.
leaf_material: alpha clip 0.5 on BaseColor alpha, both faces drawn, import BaseColor with Mip Maps Preserve Coverage (reference 0.5)
wind_vertex_colour: Wind (FBX vertex colour, linear): R sway weight (trunk 0, limbs 0.02-0.3, twigs 0.3-0.5, leaf masses 0.6-1), G phase per mass, B height 0..1, A 1
lod3: two crossed cards with a front impostor of LOD0 from the leaves atlas (bottom half, column 1)
texture_naming: BaseColor = Albedo; MetallicSmoothness = URP mask (R metallic 0, A smoothness), same naming as village-houses-b (VL)
